summary: Implement the accepted canonical semantic lifecycle without changing intent or frozen tests. The authoritative minimal Coding target set is exactly argo-mcp-server.js, systemarchitecture-mcp-server.js, semanticOperatorJourney.js, and mutationEmbeddingVectorLifecycle.js; accepted WP-P1 persistence/backfill/checkpoint/Neo4j adapters, WP-P2 retrieval, configuration, runtime, and provider boundaries are frozen inward dependencies. Canonical argo init privately composes preserved WP-P1 full reconciliation and WP-P2 readiness under exactly ARGO_LIVE_PROVIDER_E2E plus ARGO_W31_LIVE_MUTATION_VECTOR_E2E (no third flag); successful actual batch/focused MCP writes use readiness-first exact-touched durable upsert/tombstone; every exported System and unified getSystemArchitecture query freshly verifies persistent readiness without a supplied journey; getSystemArchitecture is the sole public read/query semantic surface. Frozen observations use independent raw-port effect ledgers and one filesystem-backed readiness record shared without re-fixturing across actual mutation failure, both exported query rejections, shipped init reconciliation, and both exported query successes. Stable readiness identity/recordId/canonicalVersion plus exact read snapshots and monotonic revision prove one durable record transforms from Failed/Stale to Aligned. Exactly two pre-init exported failure reads occur before the first alignment; each resume/rerun alignment has its own queryability then global-coherence predecessor; no exported read occurs between init alignments; and exactly two restored exported reads occur after the final alignment. The integration guard resolves the exact exported persistent factory through alias exports and delegated helpers; it remains intentionally RED with production factory export not resolved until Coding adds that production boundary, while five other guards pass. Credentials remain external-only, WP-P1/WP-P2 remain private, WP-P3 public exposure is retired, production runId cleanup is prohibited while existing cleanup remains test-only, deliveryStatus is runner-owned, and code-complete evidence remains distinct from live-release evidence. Final pre-coding argo.runArchitectureTests baseline: 43 total, 34 passed, 9 scoped expected failures, 0 missing criteria, 0 out-of-scope failures, and no additional deliveryStatus diff from the previously committed 28-element not_delivered baseline; refreshed records are design/KG/test-failure-records.json.
